name: Hollister Farm
description: A big two-storey farmhouse in Midwest corn and wheat country: the kitchen and pantry (A), the living and dining rooms (B), three staircases, a red barn, grain silos and a machine shed.

briefing.region: Corn country, Nebraska (fictional county), late summer
briefing.attack: Leave the county road and close in through the corn, down the driveway or across the wheat past the windmill.
briefing.defend: Hold the farmhouse; rotate between the sites through the halls, upstairs or around the porch.
briefing.A: The kitchen and pantry at the back: a back stair to the upper floor, doors to the mudroom, the back steps and the east yard.
briefing.B: The living and dining rooms on the west side: the fireplace, the wrap-around porch and a wide opening between the two rooms.

duel._comment: 1v1 duels: site A only (the kitchen); a player-clip wall along x = -3.4 closes the west half (living, dining, corn).
